title: One Each
text: “So basically, what I've gathered is that your job is to stop Motoyasu-kun if he does anything problematic to Filo-chan, right?”
“That understanding is correct. As for whether I do anything beneficial beyond that, I'll answer that it depends on my mood.”
“That's incredibly vague.”

“Are you saying it's better to always have someone around who knows what's coming? If what you want is to abandon your own judgment just because Spear Hero's advice exists, I could indulge you in that, if you like.”
“That's rather philosophical… well, it sounds like you'll at least stop anything fatal, so fine, I understand.”
“I also possess a variety of tools from parallel worlds and the future. I'll provide you with some everyday entertainment as appropriate.”
“Ah, so this part is different from Motoyasu-kun's spear, huh.”
Come again? Rafumi actually carries around parallel-world items just as they are?
“That's right. For example…”
And with that, Rafumi reached into a pocket her brother had been carrying and pulled out an apron.

“One of the future's many gag items, the Lovey-Dovey Wife Apron… an improved Shield Hero Reproduction Device, and the like—I have those too. Simply equipping this raises your cooking skill by a fair amount, you know?”
“Hang on, what's with that name? Why is it limited to the Shield Hero?”
“Hm? You don't get it?”
At Rafumi's remark, everyone nearby—starting with Rabbit Guy, even the monster merchant and their subordinates—all turned their faces away.
“…So Rafumi-chan even carries tools from the future… it's just like that one anime, except the little sister showed up first?”
“That's right. My useless brother will arrive after the waves end. I merely came here on a separate mission.”
“I see… still, your personality seems quite different from the model, doesn't it.”
“Our manufacturing purposes differ. It would trouble me if you expected charm from me.”
An absolutely troublesome creature had shown up, I say.
“Now then, having finished creating Filo, Spear Hero—what's your policy going forward?”
“Isn't it just running the circus around the country until the queen returns? We're searching for Big Sister's friend, indeed.”
“I see. So that's the policy. The circus… I heard about it from talking with Shield Hero—touring various regions, was it? I heard it's quite the large group traveling together.”
“What exactly can you do?”
“Don't underestimate me. You'd best learn the power of illusion.”
“Well… that disguise technique was certainly something of a surprise.”
“A little girl peeling back her own face was indeed surprising.”
“In any case, understood. That said, I still haven't gathered complete information regarding the parallel world. I'll continue my observations.”
And so, Rafumi ended up settling in with us. Utterly troublesome, I say. Just keep on with those klutzy antics forever, indeed.
“Well, now that we've regrouped… let's resume the circus tour starting tomorrow.”
“Finally.”
“There's been so much going on lately that I'd almost forgotten.”
“Where's Wolf, I wonder? I thought he'd come rushing over at a time like this.”
“We had him put in that cage over there. The moment he sensed Iwatani-sama was nearby, he tried to come rushing over.”
That was certainly true, I say. Earlier in the day, when Filo-tan had been put in a cage, the moment he sensed Father was nearby, he'd started whimpering away like a baby crying in the night.
“I see, sounds like he's pretty lonely. I'll have to pet him later.”
And so, as if reporting that he'd returned, Father called out to Wolf and gave him a good petting, I say. And thus, with Filo-tan now complete as well, she had joined the circus, indeed.
“Filo-taaan!”
“Hey!—Too bad, it's me!”
Splat! Every single time I leapt at her, it turned out to be Rafumi, indeed. Damn it all, I say.
“Time for Master's dinner~”
“Dinner~”
“Yes, yes. Everyone play nice now~”

And before I knew it, Filo-tan had mixed herself right in among the Filolial-samas waiting for their meal. Argh… I still couldn't manage to hug Filo-tan, I say. She had already grown quite comfortable among the other Filolial-samas.
“Master~ Aren't we going out anywhere~?”
“We're all out and about together already, aren't we?”
“Hmm…”
Filo-tan, much like Sakura-chan, clung especially closely to Father. Incidentally, the fact that Rafumi was always nearby like some kind of bodyguard was infuriating, I say.
“Father. How about a carriage all of Filo-tan's own?”
Since everyone pulled the circus carriage together, that probably satisfied Filo-tan's desire well enough already, but I made the suggestion here anyway, hoping to win her favor.
“Really~?”
At my suggestion, Filo-tan's eyes sparkled, I say.
“Hmm…”
But Father's reaction wasn't favorable. For some reason, he glanced toward the other Filolial-samas.
“Well, there's everyone else too, you know.”
“In that case, since Filo-tan is Father's Filolial-sama, shouldn't she count as a separate category?”
“Well, sure, but… I suppose, if Filo-chan behaves herself.”
Father said this with a wry smile, putting the matter off, I say.
“Got it~ Filo will do her best to be a good girl!”
Oh! It seemed like a fire had been lit under Filo-tan's motivation. But should I make my move here too?
“Father! May I be the one to gift Filo-tan her carriage?”
“Before you do that, Spear Hero, I think you'd best first supply carriages to the other Filolials, Yuki included, don't you?”

Rafumi spoke into my ear from behind me in a voice that sent chills down my spine. When I glanced back, I found all the Filolial-samas' eyes fixed on me. And from Yuki-chan in particular came… eek… I say.
“R-Rafumi… don't go putting weird pressure on me, indeed.”
Yuki-chan wouldn't normally give off that kind of aura over something this trivial, indeed.
“Motoyasu-sama, whatever is the matter?”
“Yuki-chan, do you want a carriage?”
“Well, yes. I would like a carriage of my very own eventually.”
“I-Indeed. It would be best to make one eventually, I suppose.”
Ugh… for some reason, my instincts were screaming that giving a carriage to only Filo-tan would be extremely dangerous, I say.
“Can't wait to pull a carriage~”
“I want my own carriage~”
“Carriage~”

Every one of the Filolials dreamed of owning a carriage of their own, after all. Though for circus work, they'd been pulling a shared carriage together. In the end, everyone got one carriage each, indeed.
“Well then, now that everyone's eaten, what should we do until today's show starts?”
Father took off his apron and checked today's schedule. The Siltvelt envoy was supposed to be handling schedule management around here together with Rabbit Guy.
“Um… today's plan, based on a suggestion from Elmelo-sama and others, is to head over to Siltvelt to check whether someone named Larsazusa has returned, and to try recruiting her.”
“Ah, right, I remember that. Already that time, huh. Alright then, let's go with Motoyasu-kun, Elmelo-san, and Larsazusa-san's father and grandfather.”
“Understood. I'll go let them know.”
“So that's the plan, Motoyasu-kun. Will you come along?”
“I'd rather stick close to Filo-tan, indeed.”
Father gave a wry smile at my answer.
“Filo-chan still isn't used to things yet, you know.”
“Master, are you going somewhere~? Filo wants to go too~”
“Hmm… well, I suppose there's no harm in it.”
“Yaaay!”
Oh, Filo-tan was coming along too! My motivation suddenly surged, indeed.
“Alright, let's head out then.”
And so, that's how we ended up heading to Siltvelt, I say.
